ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 58 / OppVR78] Forecast Category must be 'Closed' when Stage is Booked, Setup or Closed. Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed') ),
NOT(ISPICKVAL(ForecastCategoryName, 'Closed')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Forecast Category mismatch. Use 'Closed' for Booked/Setup/Closed Stages, and 'Omitted' for the Lost Stage.
